mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a sticky eighty degrees tonight over Verona Community Park under a pitch-black New Moon. If these overcast skies clear up by twelve forty-one AM, look west-northwest for a quick one-minute view of the Space Station. In local news, students have until July twenty-second to submit designs for the city's I Voted sticker contest. In police news, officers are looking for a motorcyclist who fled a traffic stop at high speed last week. Finally, Culver's is closed right now, but they open at ten AM tomorrow. Sleep tight and dream of tomorrow's flavor, Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
